  Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
  Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gerrard.
  When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
  Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Repeat.

## Combo 248-372-3991
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Changeling Berserker + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Prerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Tree of Perdition (graveyard); Offspring's Revenge (battlefield); Purphoros, God of the Forge (battlefield)

## Combo 372-997-4783

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal

## Combo 372-1734-6473
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Fiend Hunter + Mardu Siegebreaker
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 37 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Mardu Siegebreaker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

## Combo 372-1809-8251
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Returned Pastcaller + Vindictive Triumph
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {W}{B}{B}
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (battlefield); Returned Pastcaller (exile: exiled by Abdel Adrian); Vindictive Triumph (hand)

  Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Vindictive Triumph from your graveyard to your hand.
  Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Vindictive Triumph.
  Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
  Repeat.

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 360 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature tokens with haste; Infinite mill; Infinite self-mill; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker (battlefield); Altar of Dementia (battlefield); Sister Hospitaller (battlefield)

  Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
  Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
  When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
  Repeat.

Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{R}{R}
Produces: Infinite colored mana; Infinite Treasure tokens; Infinite artifact tokens; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite storm count; Exile your library
Start: Prosper, Tome-Bound (battlefield); Goldspan Dragon (battlefield); Flameskull (battlefield, exile); Kaya, Geist Hunter (battlefield); Shilgengar, Sire of Famine (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Steps: Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
  Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull
  When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
  Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
  Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
  Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
  Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
  Repeat from step 2

Steps: Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
  Activate Evereth by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
  When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
  When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
  Resolve the Evereth ability.
  Repeat from step 3.
Notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

## Combo 1734-3839-6473
Cards: Fiend Hunter + Changeling Hero + Mardu Siegebreaker
Color identity: RWB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Fiend Hunter (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Hero (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Mardu Siegebreaker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
  When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Crypt Champion.
  Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding one mana of any color.
  Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Crypt Champion from exile to the battlefield.
